verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Both just shrink the original onto the 300x250 canvas without rearranging anything. The supporting copy is cramped and the word spacing collapses ('withyournext', 'cupofcoffee'). 'Only this Christmas', the stars and 'www.lygom.se' are too small to read at this size. The cup logo and gift icons are tiny smudges, and the left text column is crammed against the photo while the big GET A GIFT headline carries all the weight.
